newsitem.title: USA: AT&T says Ohio report could cause delays.
newsitem.headline: AT&T says Ohio report could cause delays.

text.p: AT&T Corp said on Wednesday a preliminary report from the arbitration panel of the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio could significantly delay efforts to bring local service competition to areas in Ohio serviced by GTE Corp.

The company said portions of the panel's report are "reasonable compromises," but other parts are not consistent with the Telecommunications Act of 1996 or with the Federal Communications Commission's rules issued earlier this year.
AT&T said PUCO issued a preliminary report on Tuesday outlining prices, terms and conditions under which AT&T will interconnect with GTE's network in Ohio to provide local phone service.
The full commission will consider the panel's report and issue a final decision in mid-December, AT&T said.
